##### Project general facts

Eden Golf Views 1 presents a refined architectural expression shaped around clean forms, expansive openings, and a harmonious integration with golf fairways, mangrove forests, the marina, and the golden coastline. The development is conceived as a serene escape where modern architecture meets the richness of nature, creating a living environment defined by calmness, elevated aesthetics, and panoramic scenery at every turn.

The residences are designed to capture the essence of openness, tranquility, and elegant coastal living. Spacious layouts, generous natural light, and thoughtful spatial compositions create homes that feel refined, uplifting, and connected to the surrounding landscape. Each residence is crafted to support a balanced lifestyle, ideal for families and individuals seeking a blend of comfort, scenic beauty, and proximity to world-class outdoor experiences.

A comprehensive selection of amenities elevates daily life, blending wellness, leisure, and recreation. Residents enjoy access to facilities such as a gym, pool, kids’ play areas, yoga spaces, sauna, community parks, cycling paths, restaurants, beach areas, mangrove explorations, a golf course, marina access, beach club facilities, and a community center. These elements come together to create a vibrant yet serene lifestyle shaped around nature, relaxation, and active living.

Interiors are curated with a focus on contemporary elegance, functional comfort, and quality craftsmanship. The design standards emphasize refined finishes, well-planned layouts, and a harmonious visual language that complements the project’s natural surroundings. The result is a sophisticated living environment crafted to enhance both aesthetic appeal and everyday comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Zorah City is a coastal masterpiece nestled along the shores of the Arabian Gulf in the United Arab Emirates. This idyllic destination seamlessly fuses nature's beauty with luxurious living, creating an unparalleled haven for residents and visitors alike. With its prime location just minutes away from Dubai and Sharjah, Al Zorah presents a harmonious blend of serenity and accessibility. Spanning over 5.4 million square meters, the development showcases a diverse landscape of pristine beaches, mangroves, lush forests, and salt flats, all teeming with rich biodiversity.

The heart of Al Zorah City is its championship golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus, offering an exclusive and picturesque golfing experience. The Al Zorah Golf Club is a centerpiece of this community, surrounded by luxury residences, elegant hotels, and gourmet dining options that cater to a refined lifestyle.

Al Zorah City is not just a destination — it's a lifestyle that celebrates the seamless union of nature and luxury. The expansive network of walkways, parks, and waterfront promenades encourages outdoor activities and relaxation. The Al Zorah Marina adds to the charm, offering berthing for boats and yachts, making sea exploration an integral part of life here.
